summary: Adial Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K updating its previously disclosed acquisition of Azora Therapeutics under a June 11, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger. Consideration to Azora stockholders comprised 437,474 common shares plus 12,930.617 Series A Non-Voting Convertible Preferred shares, each convertible into 1,000 common shares. Concurrently, Adial closed a PIPE with accredited investors for pre-funded warrants covering 9,749,345 shares, and exchange agreements retiring $5.5 million of Azora notes for warrants covering 2,031,603 shares. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or close date was stated. Watch warrant-linked dilution and potential additional closings.
